scope: Whole original Utzon National Assembly, approximate2021: orthogonal courtyard office compound, complete assembly and conference volumes, seaward public shell canopy, covered central street and photographed entrance. Native154717742 merges original and later southwest curved construction; original rectangular core/junction is an explicit estimate around the exact building/story coordinate. Retain the five native seaward canopy/NE boundary controls and eastern rear edge; exclude curved southwest HOK Members extension, separate Information Centre, northeast National Museum and all neighbors. No single entrance-only substitute.

sources.facts: Orthogonal patio offices within perimeter wall. Three folded-plate concrete canopies: assembly facingNE; elongated public roof outside enclosure facingNW sea; undulating central entry-to-plaza street. Precast supports narrow toward roof.

sources.facts: Original component geometry developed from cut hollow cylinders, including columns, main-street beams and assembly/public roofs. Semi-circular folded street beams permit clear spans without central columns.
Separate later Members Building has curved atrium and overlapping curved stone exterior; Information Centre is another building. Excluded.
